hypothesis: After exactly one side of the prior completed UTC-day range is consumed, a later completed close through the frozen prior-day midpoint has positive and incremental delivery value toward the untouched opposite prior-day boundary versus the first causal boundary reclaim.

event.range: previous completed UTC-day high, low and midpoint frozen at 00:00 UTC
event.raid: first current-day 1m consumption of exactly one boundary by at least 1bp; same-minute both-side consumption invalid
event.direct_decision: first later completed 5m close back inside the consumed boundary
event.equilibrium_decision: first later completed 5m close through prior-day midpoint toward the untouched opposite boundary before current UTC-day end
event.entry: fixed 500ms activation and first strictly later observable 1m open
event.stop: 1bp beyond the current-day raid extreme known at the action decision
event.label_boundary: unresolved at next calendar-year boundary, never force-closed

conditional_stage2: Only positive, non-sparse 18/24bp equilibrium economics with persistent incremental value versus direct reclaim may authorize FVG/BPR/OI features or ML.
